mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model_registry ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_registry (id, name, display_name, repository_path, model_type, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{repositoryPath}, #{modelType}, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET display_name = excluded.display_name, repository_path = excluded.repository_path, model_type = excluded.model_type, description = excluded.description, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE model_registry SET state = #{state}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE model_registry SET state = #{state}, updated_at = now() WHERE name = #{name}
